Scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 一看：看到，here the verb means “see” rather than “look at,” so it needs 看到. [vocab list]
Run 2: 一看：一看到，when the meaning is “see,” use the resultative verb rather than the verb meaning “look.” [vocab list]
Run 3: 看：看到，看 means “look at,” while 看到 means “see”; here Shennong sees the people eating plants. [vocab list]

output.reason: All runs identify 看 as needing the resultative verb 看到 for “see,” but Run 2's 一看到 requires a following 就-clause and is not a complete correction here.
